Matplotlib and Seaborn for data visualization

topics: Introduction to Vectors: What they are and their importance in AI features and embeddings
Matrices and operations: Storing datasets, matrix transformations, and dot products
Derivatives and gradients: How gradient descent optimizes model loss from scratch
Building models from scratch in pure NumPy: Loss functions, update rules, and backpropagation
Request dedicated 1 on 1 tutoring or custom mathematical deep dives anytime

Data quality checks and initial inspection
